claims.statement: PSE states that owners of renewable installations that complied with PSE output-reduction commands may apply for financial compensation for non-market redispatch.
PSE's WOZE portal supports configured redispatch commands, compensation applications and published calculation rules for PV and wind installations.

PSE explicitly allows different roles for owners and entities serving applicants, and its wind guidance describes a temporary route for service entities submitting many applications, supporting a portfolio-channel model.

contrary_evidence: PSE now provides WOZE and calculation guidance, so simple form filling has little durable value.
Owners and O&M firms with large portfolios may build internal claim automation.

economics.acquisition_route: Pilot one multi-asset O&M portfolio on historical redispatch events, prove missed-value or labor savings, then distribute through asset managers and traders
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Hypothesis: 1.5-2.0 GW monitored at 250-300 PLN per MW-month plus recovery fees yields 5-8m PLN annual revenue by years 5-7. With 20-30% margin, majority ownership and retained earnings, founder net worth could exceed 5m PLN in years 6-8.
economics.founder_time: 15-22 hours weekly during the first telemetry integration and historical audit; event operations can become exception-only
economics.gross_margin_basis: Hypothesis: 65-80% during managed launch, rising above 82% once telemetry mappings and calculation checks standardize
economics.payback: Hypothesis: 2-6 months if a historical audit finds valid missed compensation; otherwise 6-12 months on monitoring fees
economics.pricing: Hypothesis: 250-900 PLN per monitored MW monthly plus 4-10% of incremental valid compensation recovered; portfolio minimum 3,000 PLN monthly
economics.retention_or_repeat: Monitoring is continuous and each redispatch event creates a new claim/reconciliation cycle; asset history improves expected-output diagnostics

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Command-to-telemetry-to-outcome dataset improves counterfactual-quality checks, detects missing claim windows and benchmarks which evidence/calculation issues delay acceptance
fingerprint.customer: Polish owners and O&M managers of PV and wind installations exposed to PSE non-market redispatch
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Renewable O&M firms, installers, asset managers and energy traders bundle the desk across managed portfolios; the founder's family company can open adjacent installer discovery, not supply confidential customer data
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Authorized claim-preparation and reconciliation SaaS with a managed evidence desk, priced by MW and recovered amount
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Asset owner pays per monitored MW-month and a success fee when a valid compensation claim is paid or an underpayment is corrected
fingerprint.problem_trigger: PSE orders output reduction and the owner must turn command, telemetry and calculation evidence into a complete compensation application or reconcile the paid amount

founder_fit: Strong renewable-energy adjacency through the family business and local market knowledge.
Time-series modeling and evidence reconciliation fit data-science strengths.
A multi-asset O&M partner offers scalable distribution without a founder persona.
risks: Counterfactual generation estimates are contestable and require transparent formulas.
Market-rule changes can alter eligibility and calculations.
Success fees and authorization must be contractually compatible with PSE processes and Polish law.

structure.commercial_archetype: Contingent-recovery service evolving into asset-monitoring SaaS
structure.control_point: Owner approval and submission of a WOZE compensation application, followed by reconciliation of PSE's calculation and payment
structure.critical_dependency: Authorized access to high-quality plant telemetry and PSE claim inputs, plus stable calculation rules and a channel with a multi-asset portfolio

thesis: Build a data-to-claim service for Polish PV and wind owners whose installations comply with non-market redispatch instructions. It reconciles PSE commands, plant telemetry, availability, market and settlement inputs, contractual allocations and submitted WOZE calculations; flags missing or inconsistent periods; and prepares an owner-approved compensation packet. Start with a renewable O&M firm or installer serving multiple assets, charging a monitored-MW fee plus a bounded recovery fee. The product acts only with customer authorization, does not manufacture counterfactual output and leaves formal acceptance to the owner and PSE.
title: OZE Curtailment Compensation Desk
uncertainties: Total MW outside sophisticated in-house asset managers
Observed rejection, underpayment and missed-claim rate
Telemetry standardization across PV and wind controllers
